case_name: E-commerce missing canonical + JSON-LD + security headers

fixes.fix_explanation: A canonical tag tells search engines which URL is the preferred version of this page, preventing duplicate content issues and consolidating ranking signals.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> element, after the existing <meta> tags and before the stylesheet link.

fixes.fix_code: <script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Product","name":"Widget Pro","image":"https://shop.example.com/images/widget-pro.jpg","description":"The Widget Pro is our flagship product. Built with precision engineering and available in 5 colors. Free shipping on orders over $50.","brand":{"@type":"Brand","name":"Example Shop"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://shop.example.com/products/widget-pro","priceCurrency":"USD","availability":"https://schema.org/InStock","shippingDetails":{"@type":"OfferShippingDetails","shippingRate":{"@type":"MonetaryAmount","value":"0","currency":"USD"},"shippingDestination":{"@type":"DefinedRegion","addressCountry":"US"},"doesNotShip":"false","shippingLabel":"Free shipping on orders over $50"}}}</script>
fixes.fix_explanation: JSON-LD structured data helps search engines understand your product details and can enable rich results like price, availability, and review stars in search listings.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> element, preferably after the canonical link and before the closing </head> tag.

fixes.fix_explanation: This HTTP response header prevents browsers from MIME-type sniffing, which protects against certain XSS and content injection attacks.
fixes.fix_location: Add to your web server configuration or application headers (not in HTML). For Apache: Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff". For Nginx: add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;. For Express.js: res.set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff').

fixes.fix_explanation: This HTTP response header prevents your page from being embedded in iframes on other sites, protecting against clickjacking attacks.
fixes.fix_location: Add to your web server configuration or application headers (not in HTML). For Apache: Header always append X-Frame-Options "DENY". For Nginx: add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;. For Express.js: res.set('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY').
